packages.label: חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה וְהָרַב
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of the upper, giving, divine wisdom-pole: חכמה עלאה is the supernal wisdom; כלל התורה הקדושה is its full embodiment; the letter את (as in 'את השמים') encodes that upper pole; the רב (teacher) is its human image; אות יוד is its letter-form; לי/למד-יוד are the scriptural word encoding the union of upper and lower (ל=למד, י=יוד) in which the upper pole יוד is primary; חכמה עלאה וחכמה תתאה names the unified pair with the upper as the goal; וידבר/זווג is the act of divine union that brings the two wisdoms together; and לאמר/הלבשה/לבוש is the garment-mechanism by which the Tzaddik clothes Torah speech to effect that union. All these are expressions of the same upper-wisdom reality that the Tzaddik seeks to connect to the lower.

merge_notes.reason: These three nodes form a tight cluster encoding the UNION of upper and lower wisdom: 'לי' is the word God cried out (מי יקום לי) which encodes the union of ל (=חכמה תתאה) and י (=חכמה עלאה); 'למד יוד' are the two letter-names that spell לי; 'חכמה עלאה וחכמה תתאה' is the composite concept. They share the essential nature of the upper wisdom as the goal-pole of the union, making them bechina of the upper wisdom cluster rather than the lower. The proof text states explicitly: 'לי דייקא, בחינת חכמה עלאה וחכמה תתאה שהם בחינת למד יוד'. This is not eitza — the word 'לי' does not produce the two wisdoms, it IS the encoding of them.

וידבר (the opening word of the verse) is a bechina of זווג (union/coupling) — the proof text states 'וידבר — לשון זווג והתקשרות'. This pair encodes the divine speech-act that unites the two wisdoms. It belongs to Package 1 (the upper wisdom cluster) because the union-act is the expression of upper wisdom joining to lower, and the positive thrust of the teaching is that connection. Merging into Package 1 because the coupling is initiated from the divine/upper side.

לאמר (the word 'to say/speak') is a bechina of הלבשה (clothing/garment); and לבוש (garment) is equated with לאמר via the verse 'בצע אמרתו' (Lamentations 2:17) which the Torah interprets as 'garment'. These three form the cluster of the Tzaddik's speech-garment by which Torah is clothed in ordinary stories. This is the mechanism by which חכמה עלאה reaches downward — so it belongs with the upper wisdom package as the expressive vehicle of that upper wisdom entering the world.

packages.label: חָכְמָה תַּתָּאָה וְהַתַּלְמִיד
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of the lower, receiving, worldly wisdom-pole: חכמה תתאה is the lower wisdom; אלקים (the divine name associated with nature/judgment) is its well-known kabbalistic encoding; the letter אות למד is its letter-form (the letter ל is the bechina of the student learning from the teacher — 'מגדל הפורח באויר'); תלמיד is its human image (the student who receives from the teacher); תלמיד הלמד מהרב is the full description of that student; and מגדל הפורח באויר (a tower floating in the air, from Chagigah 15b) is the image of the heart reaching upward to receive the teacher's words. All these are expressions of the same receiving, lower wisdom-pole that the Tzaddik seeks to elevate and connect to the upper.

packages.label: גָּלוּת הַשְּׁכִינָה וּמִעוּט הַלְּבָנָה
packages.label_en: Exile of the Shekhinah and Diminishment of the Moon
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of separation and fracture: 'וכשהחכמות שבעולם שיונקים מחכמה תתאה הם נפרדים מהתורה ומהשם יתברך' is the condition of separation — worldly wisdom cut off from its upper source; 'מעוט הלבנה' (diminishment of the moon) is the cosmic expression of that separation (the Shekhinah-moon loses its light when the lower world is disconnected from the upper); 'גלות השכינה' (exile of the Divine Presence) is the same condition named differently — both are aspects of the same fracture. This is the exact evil mirror of Package 1+2: when the Tzaddik successfully connects lower to upper wisdom (Packages 1 and 2), the result is מלוי הלבנה (fullness of the moon); when that connection is severed, the result is מעוט הלבנה and גלות השכינה.
